data: What is the value represented by the darkest blue colored cell in the confusion matrix?

The darkest blue colored cell represents the value of 38. This can be determined by analyzing the color gradient bar on the right side of the confusion matrix, which indicates that darker shades of blue correspond to lower values. The darkest blue cell is located at the intersection of the row labeled 'NOT' and the column labeled 'OFF', where the value 38 is displayed.
